title: Booking
description: A Shipper's transport booking, as sent to the Norvia Partner API (version 1). The Shipper is never named here: API Management takes it from the token (ADR 0005). Which fields a booking must fill in for Norvia to accept it is for Norvia to decide; the response lists every reason when it doesn't.

bookingRef.description: The Shipper's own reference for the booking. Norvia accepts each reference once per Shipper; sending the same booking again returns the original order.

pickupStreet.description: Street and house number where the goods are picked up.

pickupFrom.description: The earliest pickup time, local to the pickup address.

pickupUntil.description: The latest pickup time, local to the pickup address.

receiverName.description: The company or person that receives the goods.

receiverContact.description: Who to ask for at the receiver.

receiverStreet.description: Street and house number where the goods are delivered.

deliverFrom.description: The earliest delivery time, local to the receiver's address. Optional, together with deliverUntil.

deliverUntil.description: The latest delivery time, local to the receiver's address. Optional, together with deliverFrom.

items.description: The goods, one item per kind of package.

remarks.description: Free text for anything the other fields don't cover.

country.description: The country by its English name, a common variant of it, or its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

localDateTime.description: A local date and time as dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm (24-hour clock), in the time zone of the address it belongs to. A time in the hour the clocks skip in spring reads as standard time; one in the hour they repeat in autumn reads as the later, standard-time occurrence.

packaging.description: The package code (UN/ECE Recommendation 21): PX pallet, PK package or parcel, CR crate, NE unpacked (loose goods).

count.description: How many packages of this kind.

weight.description: The weight of all packages of this item together, with its unit: kg, t, lb or lbs. A decimal point or comma is allowed; thousands separators are not.

dimensions.description: Length x width x height of one package, with its unit: cm, mm or m. A decimal point or comma is allowed.
